task: Capture real codex and gemini provider token usage in the LLM usage ledger, which today records usage only for the claude-code host.
outcome: After this work, with LATTICE_USAGE_LEDGER=1 a codex or gemini real-leaf dispatch writes a provider-reported final usage record to the ledger JSONL: the operator inspecting the ledger sees a sequence-2 record whose usage carries the real input/output token counts (and cacheRead when the provider reports it), provider name openai or gemini, the served model, and supersedesRecordIds pointing at the preflight estimate -- instead of todays silent no-record. With the flag OFF the ledger file is never created (byte-identical legacy behavior) and the claude-code host records are unchanged.
facts: The usage ledger records real provider usage only for claude-code; runClaudeCodeRealLeafDispatch is the only path with the preflight+final ledger seam (core/lattice-dispatch.ts ~2056-2185).
The shared codex/gemini path runBoundedRealLeafDispatch (~1980-2036) has no ledger seam at all and never sees raw stdout.
runBoundedCodexProvider/runBoundedGeminiProvider capture stdout but ProviderExecResult surfaces only stdoutDigest+stdoutBytes; raw stdout is never surfaced (stated security invariant).

adaptOpenAiUsage (prompt_tokens/completion_tokens/prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens) and adaptGeminiUsage (promptTokenCount/candidatesTokenCount/cachedContentTokenCount) already map to canonical LedgerUsage.
assemble.buildProviderRecord(provider, providerResponse, ...) already supports openai and gemini via adaptUsageFor; extractRawUsage pulls .usage/.usageMetadata or passes a bare usage object through.
recordDispatchFinal (dispatch-usage.ts:334) is hardcoded to anthropic (takes AnthropicUsage, calls buildProviderRecord anthropic).
extractCodexModel/extractGeminiModel already extract structured non-sensitive metadata from stdout inside the runner -- the precedent for token-count extraction.
constraints: The raw-output-never-surfaced security invariant must hold: surface only token-count numbers, never raw transcript/stderr text.
The claude-code real-leaf path, recordDispatchFinal, parseClaudeCliOutput, and the anthropic adapter must stay byte-identical.
Every ledger call must be fail-open (try/catch, proceed on error) and a strict no-op when LATTICE_USAGE_LEDGER is OFF.
usage-ledger keeps zero cross-module imports; providers/ must not import usage-ledger.
Budget-guard parity and Authority receipt-backed signing are deferred (out of scope).
unknowns: Exact stdout shape of the real codex/gemini CLIs (JSONL lines vs single JSON); the extractor must tolerate both and degrade to unavailable when no usage object is present.
Whether to surface reportedUsage as a raw object (Record<string,unknown>) or a typed neutral shape on ProviderExecResult.
Where the new smoke registers (run-all-smokes registry + npm script names).
touchpoints: packages/main/src/tasks/ new smoke + package.json + run-all-smokes registry
